source.paper: RNA Structural Determinants of Optimal Codons Revealed by MAGE-Seq

features.wt_feature_source: rich-media wild_type_control at the same position; equality with minimal-media WT features required

model.selection: minimum dev RMSE within each feature set; ties resolved by larger alpha then lexicographic alpha string
model.final_fit_before_test_or_transport: refit each selected-alpha model on train+dev; test remains untouched until after dev authorization
model.reference_baseline: the lower-dev-RMSE of intrinsic and local_mfe
model.dev_test_authorization: full_mechanism dev RMSE must be strictly below both intrinsic and local_mfe dev RMSE
model.if_not_authorized: DEV_NO_GO_TEST_UNTOUCHED; no test predictions or test metrics are produced

primary_evaluation_if_authorized.comparison: full_mechanism minus reference_baseline selected on dev

paired_permutation.scheme: independently swap model prediction pairs within each test construct

primary_evaluation_if_authorized.multiplicity: Holm across the two primary metrics
primary_evaluation_if_authorized.mechanism_increment_pass: test authorized AND delta Spearman CI lower > 0 AND delta RMSE CI upper < 0 AND both Holm p < 0.05

secondary_if_authorized: all four feature sets with paired test predictions and descriptive CIs
minimal-medium within-condition refit using the same train/dev/test constructs and dev-only alpha selection
rich-to-minimal transport of the rich-selected models on the same test constructs
N-terminal positions 2-9 transport from the rich positions-10-71 models; no N-terminal fitting

interpretation.rcs_is_external_supervised_structure_fea: RCS base-pairing correlations were inferred from rich codon-pair data in the source study; it is not an unsupervised physical measurement
interpretation.conditional_inference: test bootstrap is conditional on the frozen train/dev fit; it does not include model-selection variability
